acceptance: The first impression is Maya's identity, not a settings list or vehicle showroom. The graphite masthead is full width and the portrait is 96px.
Earned, Completed and Rating sit on the light canvas as three unboxed facts. They carry demo provenance through the visible identity label.
Instagram Manual and creator verification Not verified are separate literal states. No verified badge appears for Maya.
The vehicle slot is modest and photo-led; there is no default canvas, fake reconstruction or View 3D control without a model.
Recent work displays actual fixture media and source/state labels, not decorative portfolio filler or installation evidence.
Private payout information appears after recent work and links to Earnings. It does not turn a requested payout into paid money.
No-rating, no-vehicle and section-error states remain compact and deliberate without invented media or zero values.

implementation_steps: Reuse the User Home shell with graphite header treatment; do not create a separate dark theme or cover-image component.
Bind record-strip values directly to fixture fields. A missing rating renders No reviews without stars; an unavailable amount renders unavailable text rather than zero.
Build Instagram and verification links from separate records. In ?state=instagram-error, retain the identity and vehicle while showing Instagram information could not be loaded with Retry.
Build the one-vehicle photo slot. ?state=waiting-provider retains the saved photo and says Waiting for provider in the vehicle preview; do not show View 3D.
Wire recent-work items to source-aware Activity previews. The Story thumbnail is explicitly Supplied creative in its detail, not proof of a real Instagram publication.
Implement edit-profile name and bio fields in a dirty-state-aware sheet, with demo save confirmation. Keep the root layout stable after returning.
Capture the masthead/vehicle view and a scrolled recent-work/payout view; test long name, no history and no vehicle scenarios.

No background asset or default 3D model is required.
motion_and_interaction: Identity, portrait and record-strip values appear without entrance or counting animation.
Edit profile opens with the shared 320ms sheet transition; save waits for the demo response and replaces the record with 140ms feedback.
Selecting recent work or the vehicle uses a 280ms single-source transition where supported, otherwise a 140ms fade; Back restores focus and scroll.
Gallery images hand off over 180ms after the new source is ready. No profile thumbnail autoplays or moves on hover.
A future supplied, identity-matched GLB may load only after View 3D. Its appearance is 180ms and Reset is 220ms. The default fixture has no model, so no such control is rendered.
Reduced motion removes all geometry interpolation and keeps source changes immediate.
spec.three_second_read: This is my working identity and record. My Instagram, vehicle and recent work are visible, and my actual money has a clear route to Earnings.

spec.depth_and_technology: The full-width graphite identity plane, light record strip and contained source media create recognition without profile cards. The vehicle occupies one small factual slot. No WebGL loads by default. If an actual matching model is supplied later, dynamically import three.js and GLTFLoader on request, preserve source materials, normalize longest dimension to 3.2 units, ground at y=0, use FOV 32, near 0.1, far 50, 15% camera margin and initial direction proportional to (4.6,2.2,5.4). Matte #D9E1E9 floor; key (4,6,5) intensity 3, hemisphere fill intensity 0.9 and rim (-4,3,-2) intensity 1.2; ACESFilmic, sRGB, exposure 1, 512px shadow map. No automatic rotation, artwork projection or zone picking. Photos remain the equal fallback.
